problems.title: Question 2
problems.statement:
In which environments is honeycomb weathering most abundant?

A. Environments where lichen occurs, such as tundra or alpine areas.

B. Environments with temperatures around 0°C such as taiga and tundra

C. Salt-rich environments such as deserts and coastal zones

D. Monsoon dominated environments such as tropical savannas and pampas

figures.alt: Both original rock photographs showing honeycomb weathering.

choices: Environments where lichen occurs, such as tundra or alpine areas.
Environments with temperatures around 0°C such as taiga and tundra
Salt-rich environments such as deserts and coastal zones
Monsoon dominated environments such as tropical savannas and pampas

solution.statement: C. Salt-rich environments such as deserts and coastal zones

problems.title: Question 3
problems.statement:
This map depicts ships around Istanbul on May 24, 2021 at 21.00 PM local time. Each color represents a certain kind of ship.

Which photo corresponds to which numbered ships on the map?

A. photo A = ship 1, photo B = ship 2, photo C = ship 3

B. photo A = ship 1, photo B = ship 3, photo C = ship 2

C. photo A = ship 2, photo B = ship 1, photo C = ship 3

D. photo A = ship 2, photo B = ship 3, photo C = ship 1

figures.alt: Complete Istanbul ship-position map with numbered markers and all three ship photographs A/B/C.

choices: photo A = ship 1, photo B = ship 2, photo C = ship 3
photo A = ship 1, photo B = ship 3, photo C = ship 2
photo A = ship 2, photo B = ship 1, photo C = ship 3
photo A = ship 2, photo B = ship 3, photo C = ship 1

solution.statement: D. photo A = ship 2, photo B = ship 3, photo C = ship 1

problems.title: Question 15
problems.statement:
Vermeer painted The Astronomer and The Geographer in the 17th century.

Which one is more likely The Geographer and why?

A. The left because of the interest in the Earth's movement.

B. The left because of the dividers used for measuring distances.

C. The right because of the presence of the maps.

D. The right because of the celestial globe.

figures.alt: Both original Vermeer painting reproductions,kept in their original left/right order.

choices: The left because of the interest in the Earth's movement.
The left because of the dividers used for measuring distances.
The right because of the presence of the maps.
The right because of the celestial globe.

solution.statement: B. The left because of the dividers used for measuring distances.

choices: Cyclogenesis, the two low pressure systems will merge into one system

Fujiwhara effect, the two low pressure systems will circle each other clockwise

problems.title: Question 20
problems.statement:

To what purpose are grass strips replaced by rocks in these cities?

B. To get local dwellers more involved in their local geology.

C. To reduce reflection of sun rays and thereby reduce the urban heat island.

D. To prevent unsheltered people to pitch their tents.

figures.alt: Both original street photographs showing the replaced grass strips.

choices: To improve infiltration rates to cope with more intensive rainfall.
To get local dwellers more involved in their local geology.
To reduce reflection of sun rays and thereby reduce the urban heat island.
To prevent unsheltered people to pitch their tents.

solution.statement: D. To prevent unsheltered people to pitch their tents.

D. The orange species is feeding in area A in July and the blue species is feeding in area B in July.

figures.alt: Full Pacific migration map,including both A/B areas,all coloured tracks and original turtle photographs.

choices: The orange species is breeding in area A in July and the blue species is breeding in area B in July.
The orange species is breeding in area A in July and the blue species is feeding in area B in July.
The orange species is feeding in area A in July and the blue species is breeding in area B in July.

solution.statement: B. The orange species is breeding in area A in July and the blue species is feeding in area B in July.

problems.title: Question 29
problems.statement:
Once the natural resource phosphate got exhausted on the Pacific island Nauru, the economy became worse than it was before discovery of the resource. One cause of this so-called ‘Dutch disease’ is the unemployed manpower.

What is seen to be the second cause of the 'Dutch disease'?

A. As a low-lying country, Nauru suffered increase subsidence by mining

B. Increasing wealth diseases (e.g. heart attacks and obesity-levels up to 71%), decreasing productivity.

C. The island inherits an import-oriented infrastructure from the mining industry.

D. The boom period has either retarded or killed non-phosphate industries.

figures.alt: Full original Nauru resource with island photograph,mine photograph and 1960–2015 export chart.

choices: As a low-lying country, Nauru suffered increase subsidence by mining
Increasing wealth diseases (e.g. heart attacks and obesity-levels up to 71%), decreasing productivity.
The island inherits an import-oriented infrastructure from the mining industry.
The boom period has either retarded or killed non-phosphate industries.

solution.statement: D. The boom period has either retarded or killed non-phosphate industries.
